title: Work on a Ticket
subtitle: A day of an analyst in Sentinel Aura

outro.title: That's the loop
outro.subtitle: Find your Tickets, understand them, record what you learn, and trace every change.

steps.caption: Open the view Assigned to me
steps.narration: You land on the New view, the queue of new Tickets. To see your Tickets in Analysis or Analyzed, open the view Assigned to me.

steps.caption: The attention summary counts the urgent work
steps.narration: Next to the heading, the attention summary counts the active P1 Tickets, the embargoes that have expired, and the Tickets overdue in each phase, from Triage to QA.

steps.caption: Each row shows its next deadline
steps.narration: In the list, the Deadline column shows the next deadline of each Ticket, in red once it has passed.

steps.caption: Select the priority to see why
steps.narration: The priority in the heading explains itself: select it.

steps.caption: The explanation says who set it and when
steps.narration: This priority is an override: the explanation says who set it and when, and the priority that Sentinel computed from the severity and the exploitation.

steps.caption: Press Escape to close it
steps.narration: Press Escape to close the explanation.

steps.caption: Open the tab References
steps.narration: To read the advisories, patches, and reports about the Ticket, open the tab References.

steps.caption: Select Add reference
steps.narration: To record a new one, select Add reference.

steps.caption: Enter its address
steps.narration: Enter the address of the page.

steps.caption: Enter a title
steps.narration: Enter a title: it is optional, and makes the reference easier to find.

steps.caption: Select Add reference in the dialog
steps.narration: Select Add reference in the dialog to add it to the Ticket.

steps.caption: The reference is on the Ticket
steps.narration: The new reference shows in the table: a manual reference, uncategorized, with the time it was added.

steps.caption: Open the tab Audit log
steps.narration: To see every change of the Ticket, and what Sentinel did by itself, open the tab Audit log.

steps.caption: Your change is the latest event
steps.narration: The reference that you added is the latest event, with who added it and when.
